title: Oroqen language
description: Tungusic language spoken in Inner Mongolia and Heilongjiang
extract: Oroqen, also known as Orochon, Oronchon, Olunchun, Elunchun or Ulunchun, is a Northern Tungusic language spoken in the People's Republic of China. Dialects are Gankui and Heilongjiang. Gankui is the standard dialect. It is spoken by the Oroqen people of Inner Mongolia and Heilongjiang in Northeast China.
